Subject: Strategy lighthouse: QBR prep & weekly status

Team — sending a concise lighthouse update to frame our QBR narrative and flag a few decisions we need by EOD Friday. Deck attached (v3) and I exported the OKR dashboard slice for the QBR appendix. High-level below.

Wins:
- Latency footprint: P95 inference latency reduced 12% week-over-week after kernel tuning; customer-facing latency tests with Acme show 8–10% improvement at 1kQPS.
- Cost efficiency: Optimize plans for long-tail prompt caching rolled out to Dedicated; early telemetry indicates 7% token-cost delta.
- Sales momentum: Acme pilot extended to include reranking flow (Emily confirmed this morning).

Risks / open blockers:
1) Capacity headroom: we are within 10% of target concurrency on cluster-a during peak test windows; risk of throttling if Acme expands realtime usage in pilot. (See note in dashboard tab "capacity_risks").
2) QBR narrative gap: need customer quote and one example slide showing before/after customer latency improvements for the deck.
3) Compliance scheduling: Nimbus requested an evidence package for SOC change-log by next Wed; we need SOC owner alignment and one contact to compile artifacts.

Asks (requested owners & due dates):
- Laura: approve two customer-facing slides in the attached deck and provide a short quote (one sentence) from our exec sponsor — due Fri 12:00pm PT.
- Karthik: confirm whether we can open a 2-node burst pool for cluster-a for the remainder of the month (ops + cost ok?) — due Fri COB.
- Marcus: own the Nimbus SOC evidence compilation; coordinate with Security on artifacts and confirm point-of-contact — due Mon EOD.

Quick next steps: if we can lock Laura's quote and Karthik's capacity answer by Friday, I will finalize the QBR deck and circulate to board distro on Monday morning.

Attachments: QBR_lighthouse_deck_v3.pptx (slides), Lighthouse_OKR_dashboard.csv (timelines + telemetry)

Jonas Weber
Head of Strategy & Ops
Redwood Inference
